stem: Which of these can replace sentence 8 to express a more effective controlling idea for this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: It’s the deepest known nest of any vertebrate, the nest of the yellow-spotted goanna.

options.label: B
options.text: Around the world, scientists are discovering new nests like these that amaze them.

options.label: C
options.text: This nest could be a remarkable new discovery, but first they must investigate further.

options.label: D
options.text: They were curious as they had been looking for a particular nest for a very long time.
